body:
## Project goal
Deliver a private personal PAL that retains relevant conversational context, accepts natural requests, asks only indispensable human judgments/content, prepares authorized reversible local results, verifies outcomes and returns results/blockers/decisions without requiring the user to manage internal tasks.

## Authority and plan
G-001 governance ACTIVE by direct user instruction. Overall product plan P-001 v1 PROPOSED / HR-PLAN-001 awaiting direct human adoption, hash: 6c1a733769b29557fe0f162957989981e5b4ad9cb7d0a01767c883dde1a8eb21. Canonical proposal: docs/plans/P-001-v1.md; status/answers: DECISIONS.md D-022; continuation: STATE.md. Stable-1 independently ACTIVE under D-021. Permission approval does not adopt future product scope.

## Project acceptance
G-P01: every required adopted milestone gate with release-version evidence PASS.
G-P02: precommitted integrated workloads/rubric prove context → recall → request → necessary question → local preparation → verified return, not just isolated components.
G-P03: control/security/forget/recovery/bounded official cost and blocker audit hold at integration.
G-P04: authentic human overall usefulness, final suite/version/use/limits record and project-goal audit before closure.
All project gates are NOT_RUN until the plan is adopted and demonstrated. Closed child issues are not project completion. Stable-0 completion remains intact, not overall completion.

## Goal loops and checkpoints
Each Issue: goal/criteria/dependencies → bounded unit → required review → test/implement/verify/evidence/commit/push → evaluate unit contribution → next unmet condition. Close only after objective verification. Milestone aggregates but independently verifies its user-visible promise. Project independently verifies integrated usefulness.
Checkpoints: coherent green unit, Issue exit, milestone exit/entry, and defect/repeated cause/user feedback/assumption failure. Record goal verdict, evidence/version, remaining uncertainty, plan impact and exact next step. No timer/checkpoint keepalive.

## Plan changes
Material plan/scope/acceptance/priority change: Opus discuss/agreement → versioned proposal with evidence/delta/recommendation/affected vs independent work → actual targeted human decision → canonical docs/GitHub activation. Pending decision blocks only its dependencies. Routine technical choices/bug fixes within approved scope remain autonomous. Only ACTIVE approved milestones enter execution.

## Next
Stable-1 Issues#3/#4 CLOSED; Issue#5 finite real functionality N1-05/06 PASS on605791e,92 tests PASS, authentic new-flow evaluation N1-07 pending and N1-08 final release audit NOT_RUN. Receive scoped HR-STABLE1-001 answer, then diagnose/retest or complete final audit/private Stable-1 release. Evidence: evidence/functional/stable1-20261007-run2/README.md; original FAIL/timing VOID retained. This is milestone progress, not global completion. HR-PLAN-001 future activation waits independently. Projects board pending actual GitHub device authorization; this Issue is project-level tracking, not a claimed Projects board.
